customManagers.description: Match deps in pyproject.toml that are also pinned in environment.yml; resolve via conda-forge so PRs only open once a release is on both channels. Every pinned dep in pyproject.toml is mirrored in environment.yml, so this alternation lists them all — and must mirror the matchPackageNames list in the pep621-disable packageRule below. The optional `(?:[<>=,"][^"]*?)?` group after depName forces a constraint separator (`<`, `>`, `=`, `,`, or the closing quote) to follow, so a short name cannot prefix-match a longer package name. Lookaheads can't be used here because Renovate's regex engine (re2) rejects them with `invalid perl operator: (?!`. The alternation is ordered longest name first (so pytest-benchmark and pytest-cov precede pytest, mkdocstrings-python precedes mkdocs, pandas-stubs precedes pandas) and left-to-right alternation therefore never picks a prefix over the full name; keep that ordering when adding entries.

packageRules.description: One PR per dependency, grouping updates across pyproject.toml and environment.yml
Replace (don't widen) Python version in setup-python

Disable pep621 for deps that are also tracked in environment.yml; the custom.regex manager above handles them via conda-forge so PRs only open once the new version is on both PyPI and conda-forge. This covers every pinned dep in pyproject.toml — pep621 stays enabled only as a fallback for a dep that has not been mirrored into environment.yml yet. IMPORTANT: keep this list in sync with the regex alternation in the pyproject.toml customManager above.
Group pre-commit hook bumps into one PR
